reviews.x: Love this brow pencil!!!! I have been contemplating getting my brows done because I'm tired of my brows wearing off half way through my day well this brow pencil gives me all day coverage and it's still on when I take my makeup off after a long day!!!!
I’m currently going through chemo and have no eyebrows. This product is very easy to use and looks pretty realistic. Plus they don’t rub off but are easily removed in the shower.

Being over 65 my eyebrows have been thinning over the years. I saw this advertised and it had good ratings so I decided to give it a try. It's just what I said, "AMAZING"!!! It's easy to apply and the finished result doesn't look like it's a painted on eyebrow. I give this a 5 star for everything and would highly recommend it to future buyers!

Got my new eyebrows in mail today.  Magically my baby caterpillars grew into gorgeous mama size ones.  Papa caterpillar loved the look.  And the eyebrow pen, tweezers and brow shaper templates were just an extra nice bonus!  Thank you.

I have very sparse eyebrows so powders, gels, and pencils always looked fake. I bought this pen to try before considering real microblading. I am so happy with this product. You can really control how much product you put on your brows, and the tri-tip is awesome at creating a more authentic look. It also stays on much longer than other products I have tried. I will definitely buy this again and highly recommend!

Okay so I’ve always paid 45+ dollars for the Beverly Hills Anastasia dip brow and wasn’t quite satisfied but so far that was the best I could find .. until now! This eyebrow pen is so easy to use you just sketch on your eyebrows and it looks super natural ! The pen has three points so they sketch symmetrically !! Then it comes with amazing tweezers , and eyebrow blade AND stencils . I highly recommend this product !!

Love this product! It’s so easy to use; doesn’t take much time to make your eyebrows perfect 👌🏻 And it DOESN’T  look like you drew them on your face! Natural look! Love the fact it doesn’t just disappear off your face when you sweat.

I really like this product. There is a learning curve to applying it but once you get the hang of it it’s great. The color is right on and it lasts! Don’t be too heavy handed, light strokes go a long way to keeping the color even and not splotchy. I’m between a medium brown and dark brown. I usually go for a darker brown because often a lighter brown takes a reddish tone on me. The chestnut is perfect for me!
I loved that it’s not dried out like the ones i bought from other sellers
It's a great touch up in between my tattooing.

It's a marker....that melts and runs into your eyes when you sweat. I'm in Arizona and it is 115 degrees right now. I was hoping this would work. Honestly did not like how it applies...its like a thin marker. Doesn't really cover grey eyebrows or look realistic on areas that need filling in. I requested a refund but they also want me to send it back. I am not sure why, it's been used but ok, I will send it back. LOL..I do not recommend!!

I was happy when I first used the eyebrow liner, very fluid and came out quickly.  Since my first use, it barely comes out, seems to had only the first application available for proper use.  I have to shake it down to try to get fluid to even use and press hard on my eyebrows.  It stays on well.  And the brown was a bit darker than expected.

reviews.t: Not impressed. No bribes should be needed.
reviews.x: It does smudge. It comes with a bribery note to not give them a bad review which I found very offensive. And the pen doesn’t deliver sharp enough lines to distinguish it from a regular brow pencils. Not impressed. It’s a good idea but the execution not so much.
It is not waterproof. not even close, as soon as water touches it the product will start dissolving and dripping. Not worth the money.

This product works surprisingly well. The chestnut is a good natural color (my hair is brownish black. It was easy to apply and didn’t smear. The extra items that come in the kit are nice. Great product for the price.

reviews.t: Hard to use for natural look
reviews.x: Couldn’t use way too much product on my eyes. Very dark.  Hard to make it look natural. I am a cosmetologist. Worked with make up all the time

reviews.t: This brow pen gives my eyebrows life!
reviews.x: I love that this eyebrow tattoo pen is the perfect color to match my brows (chestnut). Its moisture wicking feature keeps my brows from looking too wet. I'm not a makeup artist but this pen gives me the glamour look that I desire. The magic lies in the four soft fork tips. These fork tips give my eyebrows their natural hair-like appearance. I love that it's smudge-proof as I wear mine all day without having to reapply. The tattoo pen is lightweight, portable, and very easy to use. With its slim

This is by far my favorite brow pencil/pen EVER! The markings can be completely precise, or you can add a little flow to the brows for a more natural looking. I do apply the brow color before the rest of my makeup so I can lighten the color a bit because I have an extremely fair complexion. Also, the brown razor is AMAZING. It’s helping me keep certain areas fresh without over plucking so my brows can fill out some more. Overall, this product is beyond five stars and I highly encourage you to te
Ink does not flow very well and when shaken to move liquid down, splatters everywhere

reviews.t: Like how easy this is to use. Smudge free.
reviews.x: I've only used this twice but so far I'm really liking it. I like the 3 eyebrow stencils they send in the package so you can pick how you want your brows to look. It's a little awkward at first trying to do both eyebrows the same but I finally got it. The color doesn't smudge or clump and I really like that. Once you get it on its not going anywhere. 'm not real crazy about the little tweezers. They work good but be very careful. I've pinched my skin a couple of times because they get so close.

I really like this product. The ease of application, and the brown color is perfect with my hair. It does not look like fake brows. It dried quickly on the brow. I would recommend this for a nicely shaped brow. No mess and simple.
I used it one time only and the pen dried out immediately. Also the brush is very soft so it bents easily not allowing you to do a hair design. Overall don't waist your money.

reviews.t: ALL LINED UP & READY TO GO
reviews.x: Finally! While a lot of women have sparse eyebrows, menopause completely took mine away.  I've spent years using waterproof eyebrow pencils, pomades and She-lac to keep them on my face for a few days.  While I've accomplished keeping my eyebrows for up to a week with minimal touch ups, they were too opaque and unnatural looking (though they did give a nice finish to my face.)  But these pens are now my saving grace. I use a stencil to put on some waterproof pomade and let it set for a few moment

Wow. As someone with a skinny eyebrow shape and yet thicker hairs on my eyebrows, it’s been hard for me to shop for eyebrow products my entire life. I’ve tried everything from the beloved Anastasia’s to higher end brands like Tom Ford and Charlotte Tillbury, even drugstore products and Japanese and Korean products and I think I’ve finally found my holy grail. This kept on me all day at work, even though I had to walk for a good distance in the rain to my car. It didn’t smudge or budge a bit for

reviews.t: Not waterproof or smudge proof during workouts
reviews.x: I gave a rating of one star for MOISTURE WICKING and SMUDGE PROOF because it listed as waterproof and perfect for wearing to workout and would not smudge or run even with sweatiest workouts. It is not waterproof, it does not stay during heavy sweaty workouts nor light sweat workouts. It is great if you wear it during the day and/or night that don’t involve intense or moderate gym workouts. I wear it outside of the gym but have to add a darker shade of brown eyebrow powder over the eyebrow pen be

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for looking natural and realistic, not like it was drawn on.
Many reviewers find the product easy to apply and long-lasting, staying on through the day and sweat.
Some reviewers report the product smudges, runs, or dissolves with sweat and water, and is not waterproof.
A few reviewers complain the pen dries out or stops dispensing product after the first use.
Reviewers appreciate the included bonus items and good value for the price.

qa.answer: Reviews indicate it is not waterproof, with multiple customers reporting it dissolves or drips when water touches it [1][2]. One review also states it does smudge [5], while another notes it does not stay during sweaty workouts [1].

claims.text: It is not waterproof and dissolves or drips when water touches it.
It does not stay during heavy or light sweaty workouts.

qa.q: How long does it last through the day?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on longevity: some say it gives all-day coverage and is still on when removing makeup after a long day [3], and that it lasts [4], while others report it dried up after the first use and barely comes out [2][5].

claims.text: It gives all-day coverage and is still on when removing makeup after a long day.
It dried up after the first use and barely comes out.

qa.q: Is the dark brown shade natural-looking?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on whether the dark brown shade looks natural: some say the brown color looks natural and not fake [1][2], while one reviewer found it very dark and hard to make look natural [4].

claims.text: Some reviewers say the brown color looks natural and not like fake brows.
One reviewer found it very dark and hard to make it look natural.

qa.q: Is it easy to apply for beginners?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on ease of use: some say it's easy to apply [2][4][5], while others found it hard or difficult [3][6].

claims.text: Some reviewers found it easy to apply.
Other reviewers found it hard or difficult to use.

qa.q: Does it smudge or fade with sweat?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it does not stay during sweaty workouts [1] and that it melts and runs into the eyes when you sweat [5], while another says it doesn't just disappear off your face when you sweat [6].

claims.text: It does not stay during heavy or light sweaty workouts.
It melts and runs into the eyes when you sweat.
It doesn't just disappear off your face when you sweat.
